name: Right Sholder Tunic
shortDescription: A leather and metal reinterpretation of an Amazon tunic, replacing the original soft materials with armored components on the right side.
description: The Right Shoulder Tunic is based on a tunic sold on Amazon. I changed the material construction by using leather instead of fleece and replacing the pleather elements on the right side with metal.
The metal components include the breastplate and tasset, giving the design a more armored construction while keeping the general tunic concept of the original inspiration.
